formal_statement: ¬ (∀ (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (x2 : List ℕ),   PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x1 →     x2.length ≤ (2 : ℕ) →       (let x5 : Fin (13 : ℕ) → Fin (13 : ℕ) → Prop := fun (x5 x6 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => (↑x5 + ↑x6) % (13 : ℕ) ∈ [(0 : ℕ), (1 : ℕ), (3 : ℕ), (9 : ℕ)];         have x6 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) → Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) → Fin (26 : ℕ) → Bool := fun (x6 x7 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))) (x8 : Fin (26 : ℕ)) => if ↑x8 < (13 : ℕ) then Decidable.decide (Fin.ofNat (13 : ℕ) ↑x8 ∈ x6) else Decidable.decide (Fin.ofNat (13 : ℕ) ↑x8 ∈ x7);         have x7 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) → Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) := fun (x7 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))) => {x8 : Fin (13 : ℕ) | ∀ x9 ∈ x7, ¬x5 x9 x8};         have x8 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) → Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) → Bool := fun (x8 x9 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))) => PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and.eval (List.map (fun (x10 : ℕ) => (x1.wires (List.ofFn (x6 x8 x9))).getD x10 Bool.false) x2);         (∀ (x9 x10 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), x5 x9 x10 → x8 {x9} {x10} = Bool.true) ∧ ∀ (x9 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))), x9.card ≤ (3 : ℕ) → x8 x9 (x7 x9) = Bool.false ∧ x8 (x7 x9) x9 = Bool.false) →         (63 : ℕ) ≤ x1.size)
plain_statement: It is false that: Plane of order 3 (points and lines 0..12, point p on line l when p + l mod 13 is 0, 1, 3 or 9). Let a circuit of AND and OR gates, each reading at most two wires, have an AND of at most two of its wires that is true at every input of one point and a line through it, and false at every input of at most 3 points with every line missing them, and of at most 3 lines with every point missing them. Then the circuit has at least 63 gates.
title: It is false that: A step toward: Every circuit of AND and OR gates for the point-line graph of the projective plane of order 3 has at least 64 gates
